title: Cloudflare text requests speak OpenAI
summary:
A text API repair day: Cloudflare compatibility, cleaner SSE streams, and cacheable completions that can be replayed.

Cloudflare text generation now uses its OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. The shared client also removes null and undefined fields, including nested ones, before sending requests.

The text API now preserves chunks already formatted as SSE and wraps other chunks as events. Plain-text chunks become chat completion deltas, and streaming API errors return HTTP errors rather than successful streams.

Streaming completions are sanitized before caching, and cached streams are marked for replay so repeat requests can receive a completed stream.
